# Joshua Ross Spence

> Christ and him crucified. Joshua Ross Spence is a pastor, strategist, and writer in Lexington, Kentucky, proclaiming Jesus and serving the church in a modern and changing age. He writes on theology, the church, and how pastors can use AI and good systems wisely, and he consults with churches through The Clarity Practice.

## About
- [About Joshua](https://joshuaspence.org/about.html): Background in pastoral ministry and executive leadership (COO and CEO roles in for-profit and nonprofit organizations), an MA in Theological Studies from Asbury Theological Seminary, and fourteen years across business and ministry administration.

## Essays
- [The Roman Road](https://joshuaspence.org/roman-road.html): On AI, the church, and the infrastructure of mission. Rome built roads for legions and trade, and the gospel used them anyway; AI may be this generation's road.
- [When Christ Leaves the Pulpit](https://joshuaspence.org/when-christ-leaves-the-pulpit.html): On the theological and pastoral failure underneath the current crisis in the church.
- [All writing](https://joshuaspence.org/writing.html)

## Teaching and contact
- [Teaching](https://joshuaspence.org/teaching.html): Sermons, talks, and resources for the local church.
- [Connect](https://joshuaspence.org/connect.html): Newsletter sign-up and contact (joshua@joshuaspence.org).
- [The Clarity Practice](https://joshuaspence.co): Consulting that helps pastors and ministry leaders build simple systems and use AI wisely. It starts with a free 30-minute Clarity Call.
